data.name: Nimrah
data.gender_notes: Nimrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nimrah is an Arabic name that signifies purity and cleanliness. It is derived from the Arabic root 'N-M-R' which conveys a sense of being unblemished. The name Nimrah carries the meaning “Pure and Clean” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Nimrah usually hope their child will grow to embody pure and clean and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Nimrah is associated with the concept of purity, both physical and spiritual, as emphasized in the Quran.
data.etymology: Nimrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure and Clean.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nimrah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: نمرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: نمرة: اسم مُستعار من الرِجل يَدعو إِلَى التَوَكُّلِ عَلى اللَّهِ وَحده، وَالإِخلاصِ في الدِّنيا وَالآخِرَةِ، وَهُوَ مُسمى بِأَنَّهُ يَقول أَنتَ أَمَرَنى بِالنِّعماءِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُعطي وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَنعم، وَهُوَ مِن مَعانيِ اسمِ اللَّهِ الَّذي يُعرف بالتَوَكُّلِ، وَهَذَا الاسم يُشير إِلَى فَضائلِ الأَشخاصِ المُتَوَكِّلينَ عَلى اللَّهِ، وَهُم الأَذلَفاءُ الَّذينَ يَرجونَ اللَّهَ وَيَتَوَكَّلونَ عليه

data.cultural_impact: The name Nimrah holds great cultural significance in the Islamic tradition, as it is associated with the story of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) and his son Ismail (Ishmael). According to the story, Prophet Ibrahim built the Kaaba, the holiest site in Islam, in Mecca, Saudi Arabia. Prophet Ishmael was the one who assisted his father in the construction and took care of the Kaaba. In this context, the name Nimrah refers to the pure and clean environment of the Kaaba, which is regarded as a symbol of unity and peace for Muslims around the world.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nimrah also holds deep spiritual significance as it underscores the concept of purity and cleanliness, which is highly valued in Islamic traditions. Muslims are encouraged to maintain a clean and pure body and mind, as well as their surroundings, as a means to honor God and achieve spiritual growth. The name Nimrah serves as a reminder of this spiritual goal and inspires individuals to strive towards a life of purity and cleanliness in their thoughts, words, and actions.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Pure and Clean" symbolizes Nimrah is an Arabic name that signifies purity and cleanliness. It is derived from the Arabic root 'N-M-R' which conveys a sense of being unblemished.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Nimrah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of pure and clean.

historical_references.context: Nimrah is the name of a mountain in the Arabian Peninsula where Prophet Ibrahim built the Kaaba, the holiest site in Islam, along with his son Isma'il.
